svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut the panel to 900 wide x 550 tall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Have the energy-chain schematic printed on the front before

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: drilling, or apply it as a printed vinyl.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 5.5 mm holes 10 mm in from each side edge, at 60, 220,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 380 and 530 mm up from the bottom edge, for M5 button heads

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: into T-nuts in the rear posts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Display cut-out 230 x 100 mm, centred, 355 to 455 mm up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three stage meter cut-outs 80 x 50 mm, 225 to 275 mm up, with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: left edges 75, 205 and 705 mm from the left side (the meter

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bezels are 10 mm larger and cover the cut edges).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the back face sits flat on the rear posts; the bottom edge

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rests on the deck with a silicone bead (the panel is the back

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of the drip tray); the top edge meets the side rails.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the panel is flat and square to the deck.
